subject: general
question: How does the passage infer the existence of suffering within mental health settings?

options.text: It only focuses on the chemical imbalance and biological factors.
This develops from a variety of sources: relational, functional, and existent.
Only treatment by medication and crisis intervention.
It can be effectively tackled by working on one aspect of an individual's life.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• To identify how the passage **infers the sources of suffering**, we examine the third sentence: *"...through **various sufferings**, whether it be **relationship suffering**, suffering related to the **things they need**, or suffering related to **existential issues**."*
 
• The passage breaks down suffering into three distinct categories: 
 
 
• **Relational:** "Relationship suffering."
